levels.name: Sharp
levels.tagline: counts what it has seen and presses its bets

help.goal: Beat the dealer's hand without going over 21. Everyone plays against the house, not each other.
steps: Tap − and + to size your stake, then tap Bet to lock it in.
You get two cards face up; the dealer keeps one card face down.
Tap Hit for another card or Stand to stop. Over 21 and the hand is gone.
Double shows up on your first two cards: twice the stake, exactly one card.
Two cards of the same rank offer Split — one extra stake, two hands.
The dealer turns the hole card over, draws to 16, and the chips are paid.
notes: Everyone starts on 500 chips. Blackjack pays 3:2, a tie pushes your stake back.
The dealer draws to 16 and stands on every 17, soft ones included.
You may split once — two hands per seat, and 21 on a split hand counts as 21, not blackjack.
No insurance and no surrender. Short game is eight rounds; endless runs until the chips are gone.
